metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Automattic's Special Projects team for WordPress development, security, and client work

plugins.name: plugin-review
plugins.description: Security review a WordPress plugin by slug, URL, or current directory.

plugins.name: pr-feedback
plugins.description: Address unresolved PR review comments. Fetches open threads via GitHub GraphQL, evaluates validity, and applies fixes or surfaces questionable feedback for user decision.

plugins.name: studio-repo-clone
plugins.description: Back a local WordPress Studio site with a GitHub repo. Scaffold a brand-new site whose wp-content is a fresh clone, convert an existing site's wp-content into a clone while preserving uploads and the SQLite database, or mirror a hosted Pressable/WPCOM site locally — plugins, database, and media fallback — via the team51 CLI.

plugins.name: wpbakery-to-gutenberg
plugins.description: Convert WPBakery (Visual Composer) pages on a local WordPress Studio site to Gutenberg block markup in place. Includes a single-page skill and a batch slash command that dispatches one subagent per page.

plugins.name: html-to-block-theme
plugins.description: Convert a set of static Claude Design HTML/CSS/JS files into a standards-driven WordPress block theme on a local Studio site, using theme.json, block styles, patterns, and build-less custom blocks, refined to match in the browser via Claude in Chrome.

plugins.name: figma-extract
plugins.description: Extract images and design context from the current Figma selection over Figma desktop's local Dev Mode MCP connection. Downloads referenced assets (PNG/JPG/GIF/WEBP/SVG), a screenshot, and the design context to a local folder.

plugins.name: page-annotator
plugins.description: Annotate the web page you're viewing in Chrome and file each note as a GitHub issue. An overlay installed as a Tampermonkey userscript lets you name a repository, click elements and leave notes; hit Create GitHub issues — Claude screenshots each annotated element and opens one issue per note, with the screenshot, selector, markup and browser details attached.

plugins.name: poseidon-local
plugins.description: Run the Poseidon plan and implement agents locally in your Claude Code session on the model you choose, instead of via GitHub Actions. Fetches the live upstream instructions from a8cteam51/poseidon-actions each run (always up to date) and swaps the OpsOasis MCP gateway for your local team51 MCP.
